== Published English Original Virtual Set 3 wording ==
The early slip omits a bullet and the remastered slip prints one. The underlying original Decipher card already has a bullet, so both Virtual editions inherit uniqueness. The character cancellation at Vader’s system still lasts the rest of the turn.
